rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion to a narrow, administrable holding grounded in § 5110(a)'s "unless specifically provided otherwise" cap and Brockamp/Auburn-style structural cues, making him or Kagan the most probable author. Sotomayor is the clear candidate to write a lone dissent focused on Irwin/Henderson and the equities of mental incapacity, with a modest chance of a textualist concurrence (Thomas or Gorsuch) emphasizing separation-of-powers limits on adding equitable exceptions.
